zh-CN.shortDescription: 将 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 的画面、音乐和兼容视频投放到 Windows 电脑。
zh-CN.description:
ClearCast 让 Windows 电脑成为 AirPlay 接收端，用于展示屏幕内容、播放音乐和接收兼容播放器的视频。

将设备与电脑连接到同一局域网，在设备的「屏幕镜像」或播放器的 AirPlay 选项中选择 ClearCast。局域网需要允许设备相互访问。

- 接收屏幕画面和声音，支持全屏、90° 旋转和等比缩放。
- 音乐投放时显示发送端提供的封面、曲名、歌手、专辑和进度。
- 从封面生成流动背景，随节奏疏密调速，并在强低频鼓点时自然回弹；切换到设置或关于页仍继续流动。
- 发送端支持时，显示播放、暂停和上一首、下一首控件；不支持时继续在发送设备上操作。
- 可选择在新视频投放开始时自动全屏，纯音乐不会自动全屏。
- 使用四位验证码配对并管理已保存的设备；提供中文、英文及浅色、深色主题。

电脑端可暂停兼容视频、拖动有效进度并前后跳转 10 秒。音乐进度在发送端支持并确认定位时可拖动，否则保持只读；空格键切换可用的播放/暂停。非全屏视频保留完整画面，用柔和流动的背景填充四周。封面、曲目信息、播放控制及视频兼容性取决于发送设备、播放器和内容。

按 F12 可显示或隐藏当前媒体可获得的技术信息。
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
1.2.2.0

新增 F12 媒体信息面板，查看可获得的分辨率、帧率、编码、码率及音频参数。修正按当前播放位置前后跳转 10 秒、空格键播放/暂停、直接视频自动播放及断开连接文案。

完善媒体与界面背压、取消及过载处理，增强配对、输入校验、媒体会话授权、回环地址和网卡监听边界，补齐原生编译加固。修复音频管线释放，补齐 Windows 任务栏图标资源，并更新完整应用全屏截图。

控制、定位及音画兼容性取决于发送设备、播放器和内容。媒体取流使用直连，必须依赖 HTTP/SOCKS 代理的来源可能不可达；系统代理设置不变，TUN 路由仍由 Windows 处理。

en-US.shortDescription: Receive AirPlay screen mirroring, music, and compatible video on a Windows PC.
en-US.description:
ClearCast turns a Windows PC into an AirPlay receiver for screen sharing, music, and video from compatible players.

Connect your device and PC to the same local network, then select ClearCast in Screen Mirroring or your player's AirPlay menu. The network must allow the devices to communicate.

- Receive screen video and audio, use full screen, rotate by 90 degrees, and preserve the picture's aspect ratio.
- Show artwork, title, artist, album, and playback progress supplied with music.
- Enjoy a flowing artwork background that changes pace with rhythmic density and adds a natural rebound on strong low-frequency beats. It keeps flowing on Settings and About.
- Use play, pause, previous, and next when the sender supports them; otherwise, control playback on your device.
- Optionally enter full screen when a new video session begins. Audio-only sessions stay in the normal window.
- Pair with a four-digit code and manage saved devices. Choose Chinese or English and light or dark themes.

Pause compatible videos, drag within their seekable range, and skip back or forward 10 seconds on the PC. Music seeking is available when the sender supports and confirms it; otherwise progress stays read-only. Space toggles available playback controls. Windowed video preserves the complete picture, with a softly flowing background filling the surrounding space. Artwork, metadata, playback controls, and video compatibility depend on the sending device, player, and content.

Press F12 to show or hide available technical information for the current media.
en-US.releaseNotes:
1.2.2.0

Adds an F12 media information panel for available resolution, frame rate, codecs, bitrate, and audio details. Fixes current-position 10-second skips, Space play/pause, direct-video autoplay, and disconnect wording.

Improves media/UI backpressure, cancellation, and overload handling. Strengthens pairing, input validation, media-session authorization, loopback URL checks, listener interfaces, and native compiler hardening. Fixes audio-pipeline teardown, adds Windows taskbar icon resources, and updates full-screen application screenshots.

Controls, seeking, and audiovisual compatibility depend on the sending device, player, and content. Media downloads connect directly; sources requiring an HTTP/SOCKS proxy may be unreachable. Global proxy settings are unchanged; Windows continues to handle TUN routing.
